title: Categories with a Base of Computability
summary: The notion of a base of computability $\mathscr{C}$ in a category $\mathscr{C}$ was introduced as a tool to generate computability models, in the sense of Longley and Normann, from categories. In this paper we introduce the category $\mathsf{CatBaseComp}$ of categories with a base of computability, and we show that $\mathsf{CatBaseComp}$ has all pie limits.
